name: CUET UG
intro: The CUET UG form takes your photograph live through the camera. Your signature is uploaded as a scanned file.

notes: The form captures a live photo through your webcam, or through your phone using a QR code.
White or very light background, good light, and at least 80% of your face visible including your ears. No mask.
documents.label: Photograph

source.label: Summary of CUET UG 2026 image guidelines (coaching-site summary, check the information bulletin)

faqs.q: Do I upload a photo for CUET UG?
faqs.a: No. The form takes a live photo through your webcam or phone camera. Only the signature is uploaded as a file.

faqs.q: What is the CUET UG signature size?
faqs.a: A JPG between 10 KB and 50 KB.
